title: VoxaTimber
description: Lightweight tree felling for faster survival gameplay.
body:
VoxaTimber is a lightweight tree felling plugin for Bukkit-based survival servers.
It is designed for servers that want faster wood gathering without installing a large all-in-one plugin suite. Players can fell trees more quickly while server owners keep control through simple configuration options.
Features:
- Tree felling for survival gameplay
- Axe-based activation
- Configurable sneak requirement
- Configurable tree detection limits
- Optional player-placed log exclusion
- Optional leaf handling
- Optional replant support
- Tool durability support
- Simple permissions
- Reload command
- Lightweight standalone jar
Compatibility:
- Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Pufferfish-compatible servers
- Native api-version: 1.16
- One jar across supported Bukkit-based platforms
- Folia is not supported
Installation:
1. Download the jar.
2. Put it in your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Edit plugins/VoxaTimber/config.yml if needed.
5. Use /voxatimber reload after config changes.
VoxaTimber is part of the Voxa plugin suite: free, modular, lightweight plugins for small and medium Minecraft servers.
